review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责 1、负责海外信息流广告视频剪辑 （1）根据编导脚本及拍摄素材，能够独立完成 TikTok、Meta 等海外平台信息流广告视频的剪辑、调色、字幕、音效及后期包装； （2）熟练运用剪辑语言，强化前3秒 Hook、产品卖点表达及 CTA，提高广告点击率与转化率； （3）能独立完成达人风、UGC、广告向等不同风格的视频制作，保证素材符合海外平台调性。 2、AI赋能内容生产 （1）熟练使用 ChatGPT、CapCut AI、Runway、Veo、HeyGen、ElevenLabs 等 AI 工具，完成脚本优化、AI配音、素材生成、字幕制作及视频剪辑，提高内容生产效率； （2）持续探索 AI 视频工作流，优化内容生产流程，提升团队产能。 3、本土化创意及素材迭代 （1）关注 TikTok、Instagram Reels、Meta 等平台热门内容及竞品动态，结合欧美文化、流行梗、热门 BGM、剪辑形式进行创意升级； （2）基于品牌卖点及产品特性，持续输出符合欧美用户审美的信息流素材。 4、素材二创与数据优化 （1）基于达人素材、品牌素材进行混剪、二创及重构，提升素材利用率； （2）根据投放团队反馈，结合 CTR、CVR、CPA、GMV、完播率等核心数据持续优化素材，沉淀高转化模板及素材库，提升广告效果。 5、跨团队协作 （1）与编导、拍摄、投放、设计等团队保持高效协作，快速响应需求，确保素材按时、高质量交付； （2）共同为素材消耗、广告效果及业务增长负责。 任职要求 1、本科及以上学历，1年以上海外短视频广告剪辑经验，或美妆、个护、生活家电、跨境电商等相关行业经验； 2、熟练使用 Premiere、Final Cut Pro、DaVinci Resolve、After Effects、CapCut、剪映等剪辑软件； 3、熟悉主流 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT、Runway、Veo、HeyGen、ElevenLabs 等），具备 AI 视频工作流搭建经验（Prompt、Agent、自动化流程）者优先； 4、有 TikTok Shop、Meta 信息流广告剪辑经验，有爆款素材案例者优先； 5、熟悉海外达人口播、产品种草、UGC、广告素材等视频类型的制作逻辑； 6、具备良好的英语阅读能力，可理解海外达人视频内容及评论区反馈； 7、TikTok，Ins 重度用户，具备良好的网感及审美能力，熟悉欧美用户内容偏好及视觉风格； 8、具备数据分析意识，能够根据广告数据反馈快速定位问题并持续优化素材； 9、责任心强，学习能力优秀，执行力强，适应快节奏内容生产环境。 加分项： 1、熟悉 TikTok Shop、Meta、美区电商广告及信息流投放逻辑； 2、有美妆、美发工具（Hair Styling）、个护品牌经验； 3、有百万+ 播放或高消耗广告素材案例； 4、有 Midjourney、Flux、ComfyUI、即梦、小云雀、topview 等 AI 图片视频生成经验。

review_candidates.title: 仪器/仪表工程师
review_candidates.company: 上海中集洋山集装箱服务有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1、结合电解水制氢工艺流程图，负责压力、温度、流量、液位、分析仪表及阀门的选型、成本控制；编制选型数据表、仪表清单与仪表安装图纸。控制仪表采购成本，确保选型符合氢站防爆、防腐、耐温等特殊要求，适配制氢装置工况。 2、编制项目仪表安装方案，指导完成仪表安装、接线、管路铺设；负责仪表单体调试、联校，配合自控工程师完成与DCS/PLC系统的联动调试，确保仪表测量精准、信号传输稳定，满足生产控制需求。 3、参与系统 FAT/SAT 验收，整理相关竣工资料，落实仪表防爆、防静电、防腐等安全要求，配合项目验收、整改，制定整改措施并跟踪闭环。现场联调与优化；制定仪表巡检、校准、维护计划。 4、参与 HAZOP 分析、SIL 定级与 LOPA，确保符合相关规范标准；为市场部门提供售前售后技术支持与投标配合。对接仪表供应商，协调技术售后、备件供应等事宜。 5、提供仪表操作、维护相关培训，解答现场仪表使用疑问；编制仪表操作手册、维护规程等技术资料；对接仪表供应商，协调技术售后、备件供应等事宜。 岗位要求： 1. 教育背景 本科及以上学历，测控技术与仪器、自动化、电气工程等相关专业。 2. 工作经验 5年及以上工业自动化 / 化工仪表相关工作经验，熟悉碱性或PEM电解水制氢工艺流程及仪表工况，具备仪表选型、安装、调试全流程工作经验。 3.专业技能 1）熟悉压力、温度、流量、液位、分析仪表工作原理、校准方法，熟悉仪表防爆、防腐、耐高压相关技术要求。 2）熟练使用仪表校准工具（如手操器、信号发生器等），具备独立完成仪表调试、校准、故障排查的能力。 3）能熟练使用AutoCAD绘制仪表管路图、安装图，具备编制仪表规格书、数据表等技术资料的能力。 4）参与Hazop分析，掌握 SIS、HAZOP、SIL 定级与验算。熟悉 GB50770、HG/T20505-~20616、GB50058、HG/T22820 等仪表相关安全规范及验收标准。 4. 综合素养 1）具备较强的逻辑思维、问题解决能力和应急处置能力，能快速响应现场仪表故障，能适应现场出差与应急抢修。 2）具备良好的沟通协作能力，能与施工单位、自控团队、生产班组、供应商有效对接，配合完成项目推进及日常工作。

review_candidates.title: Trade Executive
review_candidates.description: Chart your Course with PIL With over 55 years of leadership in the global shipping industry, Pacific International Lines (PIL) is looking for proactive individuals to drive innovation and sustainable shipping solutions. If you're fuelled by pioneering ideas, enjoy challenging the status quo, and are determined to make a significant impact, PIL wants you as a part of our dynamic community of maritime professionals. At PIL, we provide local experiences with a global reach. With our headquarters in Singapore and services offered at over 500 locations in 90 countries, you will have ample opportunities to work with colleagues from different cultures and communities. Get On Board for a Dynamic and Purposeful Career. We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Trade Executive to join our dynamic Commercial team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia . The successful candidate will support trade and commercial activities across the Gulf region, focusing on cargo pricing, capacity optimization, trade performance analysis, and stakeholder collaboration to maximize revenue and strengthen market competitiveness. Key Responsibilities Main Responsibilities Support the implementation and execution of pricing strategies across Gulf trade services to maximize revenue and market share. Review and evaluate freight rate requests, quotations, and commercial proposals in line with business objectives and market conditions. Coordinate with regional agencies to ensure the accurate implementation of approved pricing structures, commercial agreements, and trade policies. Monitor vessel space utilization and collaborate with agencies to optimize cargo allocation and maximize capacity usage. Analyze booking trends, cargo demand, and market developments to identify business opportunities and support trade growth initiatives. Review customer requests related to commercial arrangements, free time extensions, and special service requirements. Investigate freight discrepancies, validate commercial records, and support the resolution of customer and agency-related matters. Monitor reefer and special cargo utilization to improve overall service performance and profitability. Support tender submissions, strategic account quotations, and commercial projects through market analysis and pricing recommendations. Prepare and maintain trade-related reports and ensure the accuracy of commercial data. Leadership Responsibilities Collaborate closely with Regional Offices, Agencies, Commercial, Operations, and Customer Service teams to achieve trade objectives. Support management with commercial insights, performance analysis, and market intelligence for business decision-making. Build and maintain strong working relationships with agency partners and internal stakeholders. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, service quality, and commercial performance. Qualification Criteria Personality Traits Strong commercial mindset with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. Detail-oriented with excellent analytical and organizational skills. Results-driven and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong team player with effective stakeholder management capabilities. Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a commitment to delivering quality outcomes. Qualification & Experience Required Education: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Maritime Studies, Logistics, Supply Chain, Economics, or a related discipline. Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of experience in shipping, logistics, freight forwarding, trade management, or commercial operations. Experience within the container shipping industry will be an added advantage. Professional Skill Sets Good understanding of shipping, trade management, and commercial processes. Strong analytical and reporting skills with the ability to interpret commercial performance data. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related reporting tools. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse cultures. Ability to make commercially sound decisions in a dynamic business environment. Critical Success Factors for the Role Drive optimal vessel capacity utilization and cargo growth. Support revenue enhancement through effective pricing and commercial management. Deliver accurate and timely trade performance analysis. Build strong partnerships with agencies and internal stakeholders. Demonstrate strong ownership, responsiveness, and commercial acumen. Performance Criteria Vessel space utilization performance. Revenue and yield growth across assigned trades. Accuracy and timeliness of reporting. Customer and agency satisfaction. Effective execution of pricing and trade initiatives. Why Join Us Be part of a leading global carrier with a strong focus on sustainability and innovation. Work in a dynamic and collaborative environment. Opportunities for professional growth and career development. Exposure to international trade operations and global shipping networks. Eligibility to Apply This position is open to Saudi Nationals or individuals who currently have the legal right to work in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Please note that applicants without this eligibility may not be considered.

The position involves direct engagement with senior leadership to shape project roadmaps and drive innovation in hardware design. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. review_candidates.title: Software Systems Controls Engineer I & II
review_candidates.description: Job Description Job Title: Software System Controls Engineer I & II Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 office days a week) Working Location: Reston, VA Relocation assistance is not available for this position. Engineer I & Engineer II Why Rolls-Royce? At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first. You'll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is Infinite Potential . And it's your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world's most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence. Position Summary: In this exciting opportunity, you will work in agile scrum project teams to design, integrate, and test embedded control systems for airborne gas turbine engines. The New Product Introduction (NPI) team is creating the next-generation aero engine control systems, including those for the MQ-25, B-52, and MV-75 aircrafts. The control system development teams consist of a wide variety of functional team members including Embedded Systems, Software, and Electronics Designers as well as Safety, Certification, Quality, Component and Applications Engineers. Specifically, as part of our system teams, you will focus on defining control system requirements, behavior, and tests to translate customer needs into requirements for components in hardware and software. As part of our software team, you will focus on transforming those system-level component requirements into functional software that is correct and complete, complying with the certification evidence needs for aerospace. What you will be doing: Develop safety-critical gas turbine engine control systems with embedded software to satisfy ARP4754, DO-254, DO-178C, and similar compliance objectives Integrate hardware and software components within defined architecture that supports the product line methodology Test the created embedded control system at component, control system, integrated engine, and aircraft vehicle levels Develop and modify processes and methods to enable the team to achieve compliance objectives and optimal development pace Setting up and modifying continuous integration / continuous deployment (CI/CD) frameworks, to enable software development to be easily worked by the development team Liaison with certification airworthiness authorities to explain approaches, demonstrate compliance with objectives, and close out audit findings Basic Requirements for Engineer I: Degree Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering (STEM) with 1+ years of experience in electrical, mechanical, software or system engineering OR Master's degree in Engineering (STEM) with experience in electrical, mechanical, software or system engineering OR PhD in Engineering (STEM) Must have experience engineering safety critical control systems with embedded software Needs to be familiar with Model-based system and software design using SysML, Simulink In order to be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen Basic Requirements for Engineer II: Degree Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering (STEM) with 2+ years of experience in electrical, mechanical, software or system engineering OR Master's degree in Engineering (STEM) with experience in electrical, mechanical, software or system engineering OR PhD in Engineering (STEM) Must have experience engineering safety critical control systems with embedded software Needs to be familiar with Model-based system and software design using SysML, Simulink In order to be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen Preferred Requirements for Engineer I & II: Experience in embedded safety critical control systems and software engineering 2+ years desired for Engineer I 5+ years desired for Engineer II Experience in defining, assessing and modifying control systems and software architecture Experience in the design and development of ARP4754, DO-254, DO-178C compliant control systems and embedded software solutions, or equivalent standards in adjacent industries. Experience with product development life cycle (Requirements, Design, Verification and Release) Experience with system integration and component level testing Experience with control of gas turbine engines Experience with Python, C, C++, and/or Groovy Familiarity with model-based development tools for Systems (e.g. Cameo, Capella), or Software (e.g. Matlab Simulink, PREEvision, SCADE) Familiar with verification and testing frameworks, such as Jenkins or Rapita Our vision is to ensure that the quality and dynamism that shaped our history continues into our future. It's a bold pursuit, and we never stop striving to go further, faster, and better. We lead progress, creating the technologies that move us forward. If you're driven to grow, to learn, and to make a lasting difference, this is where you belong. Rolls-Royce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics. We are committed to providing a respectful and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued and everyone can thrive. review_candidates.title: Senior Account Executive, European and Global Organizations
review_candidates.description: Description Join us in accelerating cloud adoption across Europe's most influential organizations. As a Senior Account Manager, you'll build strategic partnerships with large intergovernmental institutions, positioning AWS as their trusted cloud partner while helping them modernize and innovate at scale. In this role, you'll engage at the executive level, navigate complex governance structures, and develop comprehensive strategies that drive meaningful cloud adoption across some of Europe's most impactful organizations. Key job responsibilities Serve as the primary AWS relationship owner and trusted advisor for senior decision-makers at assigned strategic accounts, understanding their organizational priorities and challenges Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies that identify opportunities for AWS adoption and deliver measurable business outcomes aligned with customer objectives Navigate complex organizational structures, consensus-driven decision-making processes, and European public procurement frameworks to advance opportunities Collaborate cross-functionally with solutions architects, professional services teams, and partner organizations to design and deliver integrated customer solutions Identify and qualify expansion opportunities within existing accounts, working to increase the breadth and depth of AWS services adoption while building and maintaining a robust pipeline to meet revenue objectives A day in the life Your focus centers on building and nurturing strategic relationships with senior decision-makers at large intergovernmental organizations. You'll spend your time engaging with C-level executives to understand their modernization priorities and articulate how AWS cloud services can support their missions. On any given day, you might be preparing a comprehensive account strategy that outlines how AWS services align with an organization's digital transformation goals, collaborating with our solutions architects to design integrated solutions, or navigating the unique procurement and governance processes that characterize European public institutions. You'll also identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts, coordinate with our partner network to extend capabilities, and gather market intelligence that helps shape our go-to-market approach. Your work spans across multiple time zones and locations throughout Europe, requiring you to build relationships and maintain momentum across diverse stakeholder groups with varying priorities and decision-making timelines. About The Team We work with European and Global organizations that shape policy, regulation, and public services across the continent and beyond. Our team is based primarily in Brussels with members across EU member states, combining deep industry expertise with strong relationships built over time. We're committed to positioning AWS as a strategic partner in our customers' digital transformation journeys. As part of our team, you'll collaborate closely with solutions architects, professional services specialists, and partner organizations to deliver integrated solutions that address complex organizational needs. Together, we're helping some of Europe's most influential institutions modernize their operations, enhance their capabilities, and better serve their missions through cloud technology. Basic Qualifications Experience in enterprise technology sales or business development, with a demonstrated track record of managing and growing large, complex accounts Ability to engage and influence C-level executives and senior stakeholders through strategic communication and relationship building Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder decision-making processes, particularly within public sector, intergovernmental, or highly regulated environments Knowledge of European or Intergovernmental public procurement frameworks and governance structures Proven success in identifying, developing, negotiating, and closing large-scale technology engagements Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English EU national status Willingness to travel across Europe (30–50%) Preferred Qualifications Experience positioning cloud services to organizations with policy-setting, regulatory, or standard-setting roles at European or global level Background in cloud computing, AI, or SaaS sales Technical or educational background in engineering, computer science, or a related field Fluency in additional EU languages (such as French, German, Dutch, Italian, or Spanish) Established network of relationships within European or international institutions Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including solutions architects, professional services, and partner organizations Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. Company - AWS EMEA SARL (Belgium Branch) Job ID: A10529891

review_candidates.description: FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations. Job Description As a Sales Specialist at FactSet, you will be the subject matter expert driving growth for our Real-Time Exchange Datafeed and Tick History offerings across the EMEA region. You will engage with a broad spectrum of financial institutions—including Investment Managers, Hedge Funds, Investment Banks, and Wealth Management firms—to identify, develop, and close new opportunities. Your efforts will be integral to expanding FactSet’s market presence and strengthening client partnerships. What You 'll Do Own the end-to-end sales process for Real-Time Exchange Datafeed and Tick History solutions, from lead generation and qualification to solution presentation and deal closure. Collaborate closely with FactSet’s New Business team and established account owners to ensure a seamless client experience. Leverage deep industry and technical expertise to understand client workflows and articulate FactSet’s value proposition in competitive scenarios. Drive pipeline growth through proactive outreach, industry networking, and targeted prospecting across assigned segments. Maintain a disciplined, KPI-driven approach to achieving and exceeding personal and team sales targets. Utilize technology platforms and CRM tools, such as Salesforce, for pipeline management and reporting. Deliver an exceptional client experience by proactively addressing needs and positioning FactSet as a trusted partner. What We’re Looking For Minimum of 5 years’ experience in sales, account management, or business development within the financial services technology sector. In-depth knowledge of Order Management Systems, trading workflows, and real-time data environments. A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is required. Proven track record of lead generation and consultative selling. Strong motivation to achieve results and exceed client expectations. Advanced communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders. High level of discipline, organizational excellence, and self-motivation. Previous experience with FactSet products or similar market data platforms would be valued. Familiarity with managing opportunities and pipeline in Salesforce or another CRM system is considered an asset. What's In It For You At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means: The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up. Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days. Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives. A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions. Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development. Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging. Learn More About Our Benefits Here. Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications. At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. review_candidates.title: Sales Compensation Design Lead
review_candidates.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About The Team The Sales Compensation team at Stripe is responsible for the overall compensation strategy, design, and payment administration for the global sales organization. We ensure that our objectives align with the compensation program and that our sales teams are paid accurately and on time. We provide thought leadership for the go-to-market initiatives so that performance and compensation are effectively correlated. The Sales Compensation team partners closely with the revenue-generating and support functions across Stripe to support the success of our sales efforts. What you'll do You're a key contributor to the sales compensation program design, implementation, and performance assessment of the sales organization. You'll have high visibility across multiple channels, owning the performance-to-compensation structure for specific sales teams and serving as the subject matter expert for strategic advice and implementation of any compensation programs (including SPIFFs and MBOs) that further align the sales focus with our OKRs. You're passionate about sales compensation and comfortable working in ambiguous situations to identify optimal solutions for our sales teams to succeed. You have experience working across all levels and functions of an organization (preferably in a high-growth environment) to align our priorities with our sales team's motivation. You bring resilience and the ability to both partner and lead in cross-functional situations. You use analytics and quantitative data to support and evaluate decisions. Responsibilities Lead the annual sales compensation plan design cycle for specific sales teams, including obtaining input and stakeholder approval for the proposed compensation structures Implement metrics for the plans that are specific, measurable, and align with company priorities Own the rollout and enablement of the compensation plans Conduct frequent quantitative measurement of the compensation plan effectiveness and apply learnings to the annual plan design process Propose, evaluate, design, and measure the effectiveness of SPIFFs Be the main contact for sales leadership to correlate objectives and compensation Own, update, and lead the enablement of the sales compensation resources for the sales organization Own, update, and lead the enablement of the annual sales credit policies for the sales organization Represent the sales compensation impacts in company strategy discussions (e.g., with Product) Have an in-depth understanding of the sales function, product priorities, and individual sales team characteristics Support the commission calculation close process as needed Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements BS or BA in Business, Finance, Economics, Math, or Statistics At least five years of experience in a sales compensation role At least two years as a key point of contact with senior Sales, Finance, and HR leadership At least three years leading the sales compensation design process Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) (e.g., Salesforce) and Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) (e.g., Captivate IQ, Varicent, Xactly) tools Experience with reporting tools and Tableau Strong logic, problem-solving, and Excel modeling skills Very organized and attentive to detail, with excellent prioritization skills that allow you to consistently deliver quality results on time Experience working in high-growth, performance-focused environments and administering complex programs Ability to forge strong bonds, work collaboratively with, and influence internal partners such as other Sales channels, Finance, and Business Applications Preferred Qualifications Experience leveraging AI tools to enhance impact and productivity Experience in Sales or Sales Operations roles SQL programming experience In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €96,500 - €144,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our EU applicant personal information notice here.
